verses.english: “There are these two kinds of accumulation.
Accumulation of things of the flesh and accumulation of the teaching.
These are the two kinds of accumulation.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ sannicayānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammasannicayo”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of accumulation is the accumulation of the teaching.”
